title: P9.5 Anatomical Accuracy Remediation Visual Evidence Manifest

hardware_environment.hardware_verification_note: Rendered via Playwright headless Chromium on host Windows x64. Real hardware Intel HD 5500 verified for WebGL standard conformance.

evidence_files.description: QA Studio Coverage Dashboard showing updated 362-point distribution: 18 Class A (Audited), 72 Class B (Rule-Derived), 272 Class D (Legacy Uncalibrated), with 24.9% calibrated rate.
evidence_files.clinical_significance: Transparently distinguishes rule-derived from independently verified points, with Class D educational safety warning.

evidence_files.description: Lateral cranial view of Gallbladder meridian auricular loop connecting GB1, GB2, GB8, GB14, and GB20.
evidence_files.clinical_significance: Demonstrates zero intracranial bone penetration with smooth curvilinear passage around auricle and temporal crest.

evidence_files.description: Posterior dorsal view of Bladder channel dual columns (inner 1.5 cun: BL10..BL35; outer 3.0 cun: BL41..BL54) converging at BL40 in popliteal fossa.
evidence_files.clinical_significance: Verifies strict paraspinal column separation without trans-thoracic or cross-column intersecting splines.

evidence_files.description: Anterolateral neck and face view of Stomach channel showing calibrated ST1, ST4, ST8, ST9, ST12 with explicit gap protection between facial (ST8) and cervical (ST9) segments.
evidence_files.clinical_significance: Eliminates deep tracheal crossing; respects non-cutaneous visceral gap boundaries.

evidence_files.description: Medial foot and ankle view of Kidney channel with calibrated KI3 in depression between medial malleolus and Achilles tendon.
evidence_files.clinical_significance: Confirms rectification of legacy laterality inversion bug on KI3 (+X on right leg, -X on left leg).
